title: The slow sync and query-log tests fit the Windows CI budget
goal: On the kb-tests-windows hosted runner no test runs past 300 s: the test_sync.py scenario fixture, test_querylog.py applied and the test_querylog_e2e.py scenario, which start child kbgit.py sync --push and query-log pipelines, take less time on Windows, and the job finishes inside its timeout.
notes: The sync scenarios now clone the shared seed and the same-line conflict case runs as its own class (local 8-worker fixture 448 s -> 321 s). On the hosted runner (job 16794362441, before that change) the fixtures past 300 s were test_sync.py TestSyncInGit 379 s and test_querylog_e2e.py TestFixes 323 s; TestApply 262 s, TestResearch 254 s. Half of TestFixes is one querylog.py apply in a fresh worktree (51 s alone here): apply measures the whole eval set before and after each fix, so a further cut is a change to ql_apply, not the tests. What remains: a kb-tests-windows run with --durations showing no test past 300 s.
